newsitem.title: UKRAINE: FORECAST-Ukraine January inflation under one pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Ukraine January inflation under one pct.

text.p: Ukraine's monthly inflation rate in January is expected to be under one percent, Economy Minister Vasyl Hureyev told Reuter.
"We have forecast that inflation in January should be under one percent and close to December's level of 0.9 percent," he said.
Ukraine's draft budget foresees annual inflation of 25 percent this year compared to 39.7 percent in 1996 and 181.7 percent in 1995.
Hureyev said expected increases in rents and utility prices could push inflation up but added that that government had no plans to raise the prices in the first three months of the year.
Ukraine Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko said last month that despite tough economic situation, gas and electricity prices would not go up in 1997.
